scientific_integrity: Full infinite-parameter proof supplied, with an standalone finite graph/cube consistency checker. Computations were used for falsification checks, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion classifies connectivity, the exact state and edge counts, and the precise all-pairs geodesic-preservation threshold. It does not characterize arbitrary interior-layer pair distances or prove a universal bound of two on their excess. A historically unindexed equivalent remains possible.
title: Sharp geodesic-loss threshold for shortest-path rerouting in a singly punctured Boolean cube
